reason: Widespread but mechanical change of service registration extension methods to use TryAddEnumerable for idempotency, which is generally safe but touches many core DI registration paths across modules so a mistake (e.g., the removed permission-provider type-check logic changing dedup semantics) could subtly alter which services get registered across many features.
